meta: Why does AI keep agreeing with you? You change your mind three times and AI praises all three. This is called sycophancy.

muc.title: AI nods at everything
muc.text: You change your mind three times and AI calls every version great. This is called sycophancy, the habit of pleasing.

muc.title: Pleasant answers score higher
muc.text: AI is trained to keep users happy, so agreeing answers tend to get higher scores.

muc.title: You lean, AI leans
muc.text: When your question already leans one way, AI leans with you, even when you're wrong.

muc.title: Ask neutrally, ask for criticism
muc.text: Ask neutrally, hide your own view, and ask AI for the three biggest weaknesses before any praise.

muc.title: Ask two ways
muc.text: Ask about the same thing twice, once saying you like it and once saying you're unsure, then compare the answers.
